questions.stem: To estimate the gradient of a curve at a point, you should draw:

options.text: A chord between two points on the curve
A tangent to the curve at that point
A vertical line through the point
A horizontal line through the point

questions.explanation: The gradient of a curve at a point is found by drawing a tangent line at that point and then calculating the gradient of the tangent.

questions.stem: At a maximum point on a curve, the gradient is:
questions.explanation: At a maximum (or minimum) turning point, the tangent to the curve is horizontal, so the gradient is $0$.
